summary: Adopt four-compartment silo pattern from blog-posts, adapted for an engineering project
Briefs are named YYYY-MM-DD-brief-slug.md — date-first so the record of intent sorts as a timeline
Machine configuration lives in pjsvis/machines (Omarchy as reference, Mac converging) — okuda hosts no machine configs; reverses docs/starship-mac.toml placement
Hard-wrap always — Okuda never delegates wrapping to the terminal
Render engine uses string protocols over Bun.markdown's string-in/string-out callbacks
Glow (glamour) dark palette as the default
Glow is the visual reference; diverge only for an okuda thing
